import os,glob,re,json
def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

import numpy as np, itertools
def comps(A,val=2):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for y in range(A.shape[0]):
        for x in range(A.shape[1]):
            if A[y,x]==val and (y,x) not in seen:
                st=[(y,x)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da in(-1,0,1):
                        for db in(-1,0,1):
                            na,nb=a+da,b+db
                            if 0<=na<A.shape[0] and 0<=nb<A.shape[1] and A[na,nb]==val: st.append((na,nb))
                out.append(sorted(comp))
    return out
